answers.reason: The vice president for studies is a member of the university, but participation depends on specific roles and central bodies which are not explicitly assigned here.
The budget planning round is handled by leadership roles like the chancellor or president, not specifically the vice president for studies.
The examination board handles examination matters of individual students, which is not the specific purview of the vice president for studies.
Module revision is handled by a specific working group for a degree programme.
Laboratory equipment procurement is restricted to its specific committee.
Faculty councils decide on the affairs of one faculty and are led by deans.
The study commission prepares changes to degree programmes for the faculty.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for the faculty.
Orientation week planning is for planning the first week for new students.
Appointment committees select candidates for vacant professorships.
